Definition: The availability and presence of major cloud service providers (hyperscale and regional) operating in or serving the country with local or near-local infrastructure. Cloud availability determines access to scalable computing resources for government, business, and startups.
Value Name: Served remotely from distant regions only (>100ms latency)
Comments: No local hyperscale, regional access [AWS Azure Google Cloud region maps]
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first.
revision_notes: No source had been cited for this claim. Verified via DataCenterDynamics (2026) confirming Benin's only national data centre (Abomey-Calavi, operated by state telecom SBIM) has no hyperscale cloud presence, and Xalam Analytics/DIF 'West Africa Data Center Markets Brief' (May 2025) confirming West Africa had no established or announced public cloud region from any top-5 hyperscaler as of early 2025. Data-centre directory Inflect (Sept 2025) records zero direct cloud on-ramps in Cotonou, with enterprises routing to AWS/Azure/GCP via Lagos. This supports Value Code 2 (served remotely from distant regions only); original score is confirmed, not changed, though it lacked a citation. Note: a 'Top 10 Cloud Service Providers in Benin' aggregator page claiming local AWS/Azure/Google Cloud market share was checked and rejected as unreliable/fabricated — no evidence any hyperscaler operates in-country.
